Bridal make-up artist scam

By: Tarryn Crossman | Paid

Proposal


Show:

One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...):
it was suppossed to be a day filled with love, but instead these brides were left in tears about hair and make-up disasters

Summary:
Karin Roode is a make-up artist specializing in weddings. I have a WhatsApp group of over 30 brides that all allege they have been scammed by her. Some of them are very emotional about the stress she added to their big day. These plans are made months before and most have had multiple meetings with her before to discuss the look etc..

She offers a discount for payment in full and then cancels and never refunds the client or sends a replacement that she then pays less than what she charges, so she makes money for doing nothing.




Further information:
For all 5 brides this was a day they had been dreaming about for years. They had planned everything down to the t, including their hair and make-up. Which was supposed to be the finishing touch on their total look.
But for some, Karin Roode, the make-up and hairstylist they found on fb, canceled days or hours before the wedding and for others she simply never arrived for their big day.

Annerie's wedding was on the 30th of October 2021, she did a full hair and make-up trial in October where all the details were discussed and then Karin never showed up on the day. They had to scramble to try and find someone to come and do the bridal showers hair and make-up

Leandri - she is based in the Kalahair nw. So I was thinking we do her on video chat?
Her wedding was on Saturday 4th September, on the 2nd Karin called her and said that her son had tried to commit suicide and she won't make the wedding.
Antonet (another bride) was at her house on the same day and said nothing was wrong at the house.
She sent a replacement. The replacement arrived with a tiny make-up box, as she wasn't actually a make-up artist. They landed up doing their own make-up

Lize-marie
Karin canceled on the Thursday before her Saturday wedding, she says it felt like a bridal nightmare. Again Karin claimed to have stomach issues and she said she was in ICU. LM and the replacement that arrived had no time to bond and they had to do her hair 4 times on the wedding day. She has a video of herself looking depressed while the woman was doing her hair.

Emily Dekker
Had been dreaming of her hair and make-up the day she first saw her wedding dress. She Found Karin online, did a full trial then paid her in full.
At 7am on the Saturday of her wedding karin called and canceled she said she had a stomach ulcer
After Emily posted about it on FB three other brides said she canceled on them on the same day

Theunisia
Her wedding was on the 11th December 2021. She had booked and paid for Karin in full.
10 days before her wedding she saw a FB post about Karin scamming brides and called her to discuss the details.
They agreed that Theunisia would rather find someone else and that Karin would pay her back in full over two instalments
To this day she still has not received a cent

or

Eulali
She has a VN that Karin send the night before her wedding crying about having stomach issues.

Script:


Lize-M: I've been planning my wedding since I was a little girl.
JOHanita: I thought about every little detail. I wanted to remember it. How I want to tell the stories to our children.
THeunisia: It's the one day where everything is about you. You are the star of your own little story.

VO: Marriage is supposed to be a “till death do us part” commitment to one human being, there is no second take. You only get one shot to create the perfect wedding day
But according to the over 20 brides we have made contact with during this investigation their one shot at the fairytale wedding, almost turned into a wedding nightmare because of rouge make-up artist

LIZE-MARIE
I joined a few Wedding Facebook pages for advice
I enquired on the group whether there are any good make-up artists in this area. Karin herself posted something
I booked her and she asked for a 50% deposit upfront and I paid the deposit immediately

Karin Roode advertised herself on social media as a hair and make-up specialist for weddings and she seemed TO always haVE discounts for speedy payments.

Theunisia: I think It was like 30% if you paid the full amount by like the Friday
Chanelle: I had to make an immediate payment to get the 40% discount

VO: Annerie Potgieter also signed up with Roode for a discount. on this quote Roode clearly states the date of the wedding. BUT on the day of the wedding she never pitched

Annerie: We tried for maybe an hour, hour and a half trying to get a hold of her. And we couldn't. We just couldn't get through to her
I started to panic because I thought, Well, who's going to do my hair and makeup now? And then I started doing my own hair and my own makeup just to get going because I have five people that needs to get ready
Claire: I wanted to cry. because you were supposed to be sitting back, relaxing, drinking champagne, laughing with your bridesmaids. And now you're curling your own hair on your wedding day.

VO: After hours of panicking that her day was falling apart Roode finally called back

So she called my maid of honour and said “I'm so sorry I'm so confused I had you for the Sunday the next day” And she was very sad she's crying and making all these weird noises.

VO:
Roode was a no show, so Potgieter had to find a new make-up artist 2 hours before she was supposed to walk down the aisle
They just started running hair and makeup through everyone. So and then I think I got married at 4:00,
Claire: so we were 30 minutes late.

VO: Chanelle Van Dyk had confirmed Roode for her wedding on the 27th of November last year, but months before her big day she was actually INFORMED by another bride not to use Roode
Karen was supposed to do her wedding as well, and then she never showed up without calling, without a message, nothing and never paid her back the money for not showing up for her wedding.

VO: Every time she thinks back to her wedding day Van Dyk regrets ignoring this warning

She phoned me on the Friday, the night before the wedding, and then she said to me, she can't make it because her son has covid.

I believe you only get married once
So Your hair makeup is important because your Pictures last a lifetime.
If you meet your soulmate in life, You want to be special for them
Sorry.

Even though Roode sent a replacement, Chanelle had never met her and they had no connection

Link about the 27th November 4 brides with different reasons
During our investigation we found out that is wasn’t just Chanelle’s wedding that Roode cancelled on that day. She cancelled 3 other wedding for different reasons. Johanita’s wedding was one of them

Johanita: Just after 7:00, I received a voice note from her saying she has a bleeding stomach, but I shouldn’t worry everything is going to be fine
VN from Roode: Oh Johanita, I am in casualty. Things aren’t good with me
Joh: I had my head in my hands and I started crying.
It's a feeling of your heart. Just falling to the ground and shattering to a million pieces

VO: Lize-marie Burger’s wedding was also scheduled for the 27th of November 2021

Two days before the wedding, she phoned me in tears. She said that she is so sorry to tell me, but she has an ulcer and she feels bad.
She then sent me a number of one of her friends who stands in for her.

VO: Unfortunately when the replacement arrived nothing turned out how it was supposed to We started with the hair. When she was done, I looked in the mirror I wanted to cry, ” I told her that my hair looks nothing like the photo
we had to redo it three or four times..
And at the back of my head I still hoped that it was just a nightmare.

VO: As individuals all of these brides sympathized with Roode and believed the excuses she provided, but only after their weddings when more and more brides began posting on social media did they start to question her

Chanelle:
I saw that someone made a post of karin saying that she's a scam, don't get her for hair and makeup. A

Johanita: Most people say that the day of or the morning ovulating, she tells you she's at casualties with the war, the stomach ulcer, that's bleeding. So I really don't think that was a true story at all.

Lize-marie: after I heard about everything that happened to the others; it is the exact same pattern. So, maybe she did do it on purpose.

Roode declined an on camera interview and instead sent us her version of events in writing. She believes there is a smear campaign against her on social media. In her email She wrote “ .. at no stage did I run a scam she goes on to state Myself and my family experienced serious personal health complications and financial difficulty

Theunisia: As I read through the comments, I am like you. All of these strangers can't lie. Have the same lie. There's no way.

10 days before her wedding Theunisia swanepoel saw all the posts on social media about Roode cancelling at the last minute. And even though she had paid in full, she wasn’t prepared to risk using Roode

Theunisia: I sent her a message and I said Can she please just pay my money back. So she said, financially, she won't be able to pay it back. So I'm like, You took my money. Are you telling me you've already used it for service that I have not yet received?

Roodes lawyer then contact Theunisia with a payment plan. which was due to start last year, but to this day she has not received a cent

Theunisia: I 100 percent think she's an opportunist.

Roode emailed us stating that she will be paying Swanepoel back as planned. But no payments were made prior to this broadcast

VO: Eventhough Roode sent a replacement to Johanita’s wedding, they battled to get paid in full after the wedding and were constantly contacting Johanita for their money

her husband decided he's noW fed up so he went to the saps. He opened a case against Karin, and within ten minutes they got paid in full the amount they were supposed to get paid.


Roode denies these allegations and says she paid them timeously
But Many of Roode’s replacement make-up artists that we have interviewed are still trying to get paid, for work done months ago.

E: I did five weddings for her
Then I saw that she was taking me for a fool.

VO: Roode still owes Hairdresser Erika Van Dyk for two weddings from 2021

E: She told me she’s busy with her lawyer to make arrangements for payment to all the people that she owes money to. A lot of people
The last message was on 28 October 2021. Last year. I’m tired of asking. It doesn’t help to ask, because you get nothing.

CC: she just kept delaying, delaying, delaying the process. And then I started to become a thing of my husband doesn't have the money to pay you. I don't have the money. As soon as he gets paid, I'll pay you.

Vo: Make-up artist Caitlyn Camacho was also called by roode to replace her in the final hour and is still owed for 3 weddings

CC: I was fed up and I sent her a letter of final demand and I got an email from her where she said she would pay me

In her email to us Roode stated that she will be paying both Camacho and Van dyk back as per the payment plans. At the time broadcast though no planned payments had been made

CC: No, I don't think that she's going to pay me.

Vo: After Potgieters wedding Roode agreed to pay her back for not arriving, but claimed not to have the funds at the time, even though potgieter had already paid her in full.

CLAIRE: Are you taking legal action against Collingwood?
ANNERIE: Yes, we are. Definitely. We'll be sending her letters to pay the money back. And it's not just her money, but the money that we paid for the makeup artist that had to stand in for her as well.

Subsequent to this interview Potgieter issued Roode with a lawyers letter.
Roode has confirmed that she will now be working out a payment plan
Roode says that she has taken on a permanent job to try and pay everyone back the money owed.
She offered her sincere apologies to all involved
But for all the brides we spoke to it wasn’t about the money, it’s about the memories that they will never get back
I still haven't hung any pictures of my wedding in my house. We’ve been married for two years. The damage is done.

She offered her sincere apologies to all involved But for all the brides we spoke to it wasn’t about the money, it’s about the memories that they will never get back I still haven't hung any pictures of my wedding in my house. We’ve been married for two years. The damage is done.

metadata.One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...): it was suppossed to be a day filled with love, but instead these brides were left in tears about hair and make-up disasters
metadata.Summary: Karin Roode is a make-up artist specializing in weddings. I have a WhatsApp group of over 30 brides that all allege they have been scammed by her. Some of them are very emotional about the stress she added to their big day. These plans are made months before and most have had multiple meetings with her before to discuss the look etc.. She offers a discount for payment in full and then cancels and never refunds the client or sends a replacement that she then pays less than what she charges, so she makes money for doing nothing.
metadata.Further information: For all 5 brides this was a day they had been dreaming about for years. They had planned everything down to the t, including their hair and make-up. Which was supposed to be the finishing touch on their total look. But for some, Karin Roode, the make-up and hairstylist they found on fb, canceled days or hours before the wedding and for others she simply never arrived for their big day. Annerie's wedding was on the 30th of October 2021, she did a full hair and make-up trial in October where all the details were discussed and then Karin never showed up on the day. They had to scramble to try and find someone to come and do the bridal showers hair and make-up Leandri - she is based in the Kalahair nw. So I was thinking we do her on video chat? Her wedding was on Saturday 4th September, on the 2nd Karin called her and said that her son had tried to commit suicide and she won't make the wedding. Antonet (another bride) was at her house on the same day and said nothing was wrong at the house. She sent a replacement. The replacement arrived with a tiny make-up box, as she wasn't actually a make-up artist. They landed up doing their own make-up Lize-marie Karin canceled on the Thursday before her Saturday wedding, she says it felt like a bridal nightmare. Again Karin claimed to have stomach issues and she said she was in ICU. LM and the replacement that arrived had no time to bond and they had to do her hair 4 times on the wedding day. She has a video of herself looking depressed while the woman was doing her hair. Emily Dekker Had been dreaming of her hair and make-up the day she first saw her wedding dress. She Found Karin online, did a full trial then paid her in full. At 7am on the Saturday of her wedding karin called and canceled she said she had a stomach ulcer After Emily posted about it on FB three other brides said she canceled on them on the same day Theunisia Her wedding was on the 11th December 2021. She had booked and paid for Karin in full. 10 days before her wedding she saw a FB post about Karin scamming brides and called her to discuss the details. They agreed that Theunisia would rather find someone else and that Karin would pay her back in full over two instalments To this day she still has not received a cent or Eulali She has a VN that Karin send the night before her wedding crying about having stomach issues.
